goal: Automatically monitor Windows code signing certificates for impending expiration or revocation
Prevent release delays caused by discovering expired certificates during urgent point releases
agreement: Strong support for automated checks to prevent surprise blockers on expedited releases (fanquake)
Approved after the author added certificate revocation checks (achow101)
Suggested making the check a standalone script runnable locally (maflcko)
Asked about expiry thresholds and proposed tracking certs in release docs instead (hebasto)

categories.name: build
why: P3 because it automates certificate expiration tracking to prevent release delays
It provides non-critical preventative monitoring and is reasonably deferrable
